projects.title: Real Personal portfolio: cross-page titles and literal copy
rows: Each page's HTML title content must identify Personal rather than Modern Business.

index.html and resume.html identify Personal but projects.html and contact.html retain Modern Business in title. This is an explicit cross-page HTML-title content mismatch, not a visual branding judgment.
Resume page content must list Web Developer at Stark Industries for 2019 - Present.
resume.html has this exact role, organization and year range in its experience card. These are public fictional template details, not verified employment.
Resume page content must include a Master's in Web Development and an Undergraduate entry in Computer Science.
resume.html education cards contain Master's/Web Development and Undergraduate/Computer Science. Only source text is asserted.
Projects page content must not retain the placeholder titles Project Name 1 and Project Name 2.
Both placeholder titles remain in projects.html h2 elements, contradicting the newly authored negative content constraint.
Contact page source content must contain the literal labels Full name and Email address.
contact.html contains label elements for name and email with exactly these text labels. The criterion does not establish actual email delivery or rendered accessibility.
Contact page copy must state that a reply is normally provided within two working days.
No reply-time statement occurs anywhere in the complete contact.html source. This is an explicit text-content obligation rather than a demand to prove actual response speed.
Download Resume must retrieve a valid PDF containing the current experience and education.
Only HTML source subset supplied; the source link is not a downloaded PDF and no browser download or PDF contents are available.
The portrait must depict the portfolio owner and remain uncropped at 375px on a phone.
Image bytes, CSS, identity confirmation and mobile browser observations are not supplied; source alone cannot establish image subject or crop.
